quote: The claws of war are no match for the wings of wisdom.
It was strange to realize that a dragon who couldn't be hurt on the outside could have so many ragged holes on the inside.
There's no difference between justice and revenge.
You said, 'Hey, sparkling teeth, I totally love three of your claws but not the others, and I wish your nose was a herring so I could eat it, and also your wings sound like sharks snoring.'
Act smart, stay alive, stick together but don't be an idiot – those are our basic rules.

For most of her life, Cricket's best friends were books. Books accepted you the way you were and shared all their secrets with you. Books never told you to stop asking questions or accused you of being nosy and annoying. Books never said, 'Cricket, you don't need to know that, mind your own business.'
No way. There is a tree in a forest?
Be strong, be vigilant, strike first. And trust nobody.
What is with you and faces? You should try threatening someone's elbows or ankles once in a while, just for a change of pace.
You're not nothing.
Hiding was not her normal approach to problems. Why hide, when you can just set your problem on fire?
That's right, DIE, you little monster plants. May your roots always be thirsty and your seeds all meet a fiery death until you're extinct forever! I HATE you!
Oooh, Peril said, momentarily distracted by the idea of an enchanted piece of cheese.
We don't share IceWing secrets with mere RainWings, haughty sniff.
Ha ha, imagine Winter singing! I wonder if he can scowl and sing and look darkly handsome and mortally offended all at the same time. Probably.

Beware the darkness of dragons, Beware the stalker of dreams, Beware the talons of power and fire, Beware one who is not what she seems. Something is coming to shake the earth, Something is coming to scorch the ground. Jade Mountain will fall beneath thunder and ice Unless the lost city of night can be found.
There's a tree, Starflight said, jumping to his feet. 'In the forest.' 'No way,' Glory said. 'A tree in the forest?'
The NightWings are going to set their heads on fire, Qibli agreed. 'No, wait. They're going to set the closest IceWing's head on fire. Winter, I hope your skull is as thick as it looks.'

Want me to drop a mango on her? Sundew offered. 'You have a MANGO?' Swordtail asked indignantly. 'No, you acorn. It's a metaphorical mango.' 'I don't see how metaphorical mangoes are going to do us any good,' Swordtail muttered.

Glory had her tail curled around her talons and was holding her wings in close as wave after wave of odd colors spread through her scales. Deathbringer put one wing around her, gently, and she let him.

Terribly undignified, Qibli said in a haughty voice, tipping his snout at the racing dragons. 'We would never allow such higgledy-piggledy shenanigans in the Ice Kingdom.' 'Was that supposed to be me?' Winter asked him. 'Terribly unimpressive, if so. I haven't once said 'higgledy-piggledy' in my entire life. We would never allow such linguistic imprecision in the Ice Kingdom.' Qibli barked a delighted laugh and did a loop in the air.
Every future that spirals out of every choice you and every other dragon make for the rest of your life? Can't you hear yourself? It's impossible, dearest. That way lies madness.
You can do and say everything exactly the same as everyone else, but if there's one thing different about you, that's all they care about.
I figured maybe I'd start by making friends with some other tribes first and gradually work my way back around to the NightWings, but you're hardly a NightWing at all, so that's OK, then.
And if you are even considering setting me free while keeping him trapped, I will roast your talons one claw at a time.
If you don't care what anyone thinks of you, you can do whatever you want.
I am not afraid. I am a NightWing, born on a brightest night. I am going to save my tribe.
I am not going to let anyone control me ever again.
I don't need a hero to save me. I can save myself.
Maybe we can't change the whole world, but we can change our part of it.
You don't have to be perfect to be worthy of love.
The hardest part of growing up is realizing that the adults don't have all the answers.
Everyone has secrets. Some of us just hide them better than others.
Freedom isn't just about escaping cages; it's about choosing your own path.
We are defined by the choices we make, not the destiny someone else wrote for us.
Kindness isn't a weakness. It takes more strength to be gentle in a cruel world.
Sometimes the bravest thing you can do is admit that you need help.
Trust is fragile. Once broken, it takes a long time to rebuild, if it ever can be.
You can't force someone to see the truth if they're determined to stay blind.
Fear makes dragons do terrible things.
The truth doesn't care about your feelings, but that doesn't mean you shouldn't.
Even in the darkest places, there is always a tiny glimmer of hope.
Power isn't inherently evil; it depends entirely on whose hands hold it.
It takes courage to stand up to your enemies, but even more to stand up to your friends.
A mistake doesn't define who you are, unless you let it.
No one can decide who you are except for you.
The world is full of beauty if you only take the time to look for it.
Loyalty shouldn't be blind; it should be earned and continuously deserved.
Hope is a quiet thing, but it has the power to shatter mountains.
We are all connected, whether we like it or not.
